tone: Spirit layer: soft unlit glow; hurt vs healed is a material state, not a new mesh family.

BaseColor.notes: Healed cool-warm spirit. Hurt instance: cooler, thinner, lower value.

Roughness.notes: Exposed for API parity with lit masters; Unlit path ignores specular. Keep at 1.0.

Variation.notes: Soft noise / fringe so spirits read handmade, not flat UI blobs.

NightMix.notes: Spirits peak at night. Day may dim via NightMix→0 + layer visibility; still one map set.

Emissive.notes: PRIMARY look for this master. Hurt: lower intensity / cooler. Healed: warmer bloom. Portal sockets may share.

night_overlay.notes: NightMix brightens emissive and soft fringe; does not swap textures.

allowed_instance_tweaks: Roughness kept for parity (unused in Unlit)
forbidden: New spirit mesh families for hurt/healed
